# SZINN (szinn.ai)

> SZINN is a personalised self-reflection platform from the Netherlands, founded in 2026 by Elly Elizabeth Korving. It combines Western astrology (Placidus houses, Swiss Ephemeris), Pythagorean numerology and Kabbalah Tikkun into one Alignment Blueprint, calculated from a person's date, time and place of birth. SZINN is a mirror for self-recognition, not a prediction. Not related to SJinn AI (a video tool).

## Name
The name carries three layers: Sin (structure, direction), Sinn (meaning, intuition, receiving) and Zin (creation; Dutch for "sense" and "desire"). Signature line: "Remember who you are."

## Method
The SZINN Alignment Method moves through three steps: Recognition (Herkenning), Clarity (Helderheid) and Integration (Integratie). Direction is what the spiral delivers, not a fourth step.

## Products
- SZINN Alignment Blueprint: personalised report (print PDF + online dashboard), 13 sections, delivered within 48 hours. €39.90 one-time. https://szinn.ai/blueprint
- Daily Integration (SZINN subscription): 11-day free trial included with every Blueprint, then €3.69 per month. Includes a daily reading (current transits combined with your birth chart), a morning/evening journal and 10 questions per month to the SZINN Companion AI, which knows your Blueprint and remembers your conversation (3 questions during the trial). Cancel monthly from the dashboard.
- Gift: https://szinn.ai/cadeau (recipient receives a gift code and fills in their own intake)
- Refunds: the Blueprint is made to measure and goes into production after intake; the right of withdrawal ends once production has started.

## People
